key_sections.name: Hero Section
key_sections.headline: What if yesterday’s waste could become tomorrow’s resource?
key_sections.subheadline: AJET pioneers industrial-grade bio-transformation. From food scraps and crop residues to regenerative organic compost, clean biomethane energy, and high-nitrogen soil enhancers.

key_sections.name: Our Story & The Problem
key_sections.narrative: Every day, millions of tons of organic matter decompose into open landfills, releasing potent methane and stripping agricultural soils of vital organic carbon. AJET re-engineers this broken loop through automated micro-climate composting and anaerobic digestion.

pillars.title: The Landfill Dilemma
pillars.detail: Organic waste generates up to 16% of global methane emissions when left in anaerobic heaps.

pillars.title: The Depleted Soil Crisis
pillars.detail: Intensive chemical agriculture has degraded over 33% of global topsoil humus.

pillars.title: The Closed-Loop Reversal
pillars.detail: AJET converts verified organic feedstock into certified soil enhancers, green heat, and animal feed.

stages.name: Collection
stages.desc: Smart sensor-tracked bins & scheduled bulk pickup from food processors, hotels, and agricultural cooperatives.

stages.name: Segregation & De-packaging
stages.desc: High-torque automated depackagers isolate clean organic pulp with 99.4% purity from contaminations.

stages.name: Micro-Aerobic Processing
stages.desc: Controlled thermal aerobic digestion and anaerobic chambers with continuous moisture & gas telemetry.

stages.name: Bio-Transformation & Refinement
stages.desc: Enrichment into high-grade humic compost, bottled bio-fertilizers, and scrubbed biomethane grid fuel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure JavaScript/JSX files (e.g. .jsx, .js) as specified in instructions.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications on contact form and preset prediction loads.
Use 'recharts' (ResponsiveContainer, BarChart, AreaChart, PieChart, Cell, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis) for the AI Prediction Dashboard visual analytics.
Implement the theme toggle using the already installed 'next-themes' or local state toggle to alternate smoothly between organic light mode and dark bio-tech mode.

Ensure every interactive element and key informational metric includes unambiguous 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='predict-calculate-btn', data-testid='waste-quantity-slider', data-testid='partner-submit-btn').
Never use generic flat gray backgrounds. Use warm organic tones (oklch/hex #FAF7F2, deep forest green #143D2B, clay amber accents) in light mode, and obsidian deep pine in dark mode.
Ensure high contrast on all text elements (APCA/WCAG compliant). Never place faint green on pale white.

universal_guidelines.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (py-24, gap-8 to gap-12), avoid cramped containers.
universal_guidelines.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header and dashboard telemetry panels with backdrop-blur-xl and delicate 1px border-emerald-900/10.
anti_slop_rules: No generic centered plain text with floating icons.
No robotic placeholder text or lorem ipsum; provide realistic circular bio-tech metrics.
Hero image must have subtle gradient overlay (bg-black/30 to bg-black/45) so the photographic quality shines through.
